name: sports
description: Sports records as published: fixtures with reschedule history, results with every correction, forfeit, award or annulment kept as a revision, lineups, and competition tables as of a date replayed under the stated rules beside the published table; reviewable identity, official-result forecast resolution and subscription monitors. No odds, predictions or medical data.

query_examples.intent: What did the league table look like on a date
query_examples.semantics: replayed from results published by the end of that date under the stated rule and deductions, beside the nearest published table; corrections and forfeits cited with the deciding body
every result revision in the source's own date order, other sources side by side
postponements and new kickoffs, each move citing both revisions

query_examples.intent: Which fixtures did a club play in August
query_examples.semantics: fixtures and results from every source the club's reviewed identity joins

exclusions: odds, betting markets, tips, value bets or betting advice
player medical, injury-detail, biometric or tracking data
personal data beyond published sporting records (name as published, team, appearance, published transfer)
scraping of sites whose terms forbid it
results inferred for a match without a published result
merging sources' results or silently resolving a table disagreement
